{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df[df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999].shape[0]}')

# Check distribution of severity
print(f'Baseline severity distribution:\n{df["severity"].value_counts(normalize=True)}')"}
